It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 28, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 22, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Late at night, a young traveler and her Chansey lose their way in Eterna Forest. They soon stumble upon a house—but what waits inside? ==Plot== [[Cheryl]] and her {{p|Chansey}} are journeying through the [[Eterna Forest]]. Realizing that it will soon be nighttime, they decide to find a place to stay and chance upon the [[Old Chateau]]. Inside, a {{tc|Butler}} invites them to stay the night, and treats them to what appears to be a lavish feast. However, Cheryl and Chansey are given empty plates, but nonetheless they give thanks for the food and proceed to eat nothing but thin air, while the butler watches on and chuckles eerily. After the illusionary meal, the butler offers to escort Cheryl and Chansey to their rooms. Cheryl and Chansey abruptly lose sight of the butler after he makes a turn, but he suddenly reappears behind them and moves on without acknowledging their presence, seemingly sinking into the floor in a mass of purple miasma. Mad cackling echoes through the hallway as a series of weather phenomenon starts surging towards Cheryl and Chansey. Panicking, they try to escape, but fail to run away from the engulfing shadows. With a start, Cheryl and Chansey wake up on a couch to find that the chateau they tried to spend the night in is actually in a dilapidated state, and they have been resting in the main lobby all this time. Picking up a note, she reads it, only to be accosted by the [[Ghosts in the Pokémon world|ghost]] of a little girl. The episode closes on the terrified screams of Cheryl and Chansey. ==Major events== * [[Cheryl]] visits the [[Old Chateau]] and encounters a pair of [[Ghosts in the Pokémon world|ghosts]]. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Cheryl]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Chansey}} ([[Cheryl]]'s) * {{p|Haunter}} (illusion) ===Other=== * {{tc|Butler}}'s ghost * Little girl's ghost ==Trivia== * The area of [[Eterna Forest]] located near the [[Old Chateau]] appears to have been inspired by {{wp|Aokigahara|Aokigahara Forest}} in Japan, which is said to be haunted. * The note that [[Cheryl]] reads at the end of the episode is the same one that can be found at the Old Chateau in {{game|Platinum}}, likely describing {{p|Rotom}}. * In {{pmin|South Korea}}, this episode was reordered as the twelfth episode. ===Errors=== * The [https://web.archive.org/web/20161031193521/http://www.pokemon.com/us/ front page of the Pokémon website] erroneously calls this episode by [[PG11|the next episode]]'s title, "The New World". ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FDBB99|bordercolor=FD7F4F |nl={{tt|Het oude chateau|The Old Chateau}} |fr_eu={{tt|Le Vieux Château|The Old Chateau}} |de={{tt|Die Alte Villa|The Old Chateau}} |it={{tt|L'Antico Château|The Old Chateau}} |ko={{tt|숲속의 서양식 저택|The Forest Manor}} |pt_br={{tt|A Antiga Mansão|The Old Mansion}} |es_eu={{tt|La Vieja Mansión|The Old Chateau}} }} {{-}} {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG09 | prevtitle=The Scoop | nextcode=PG11 | nexttitle=The New World | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{Project Anime notice}} [[Category:Pokémon Generations episodes|10]] [[Category:Episodes written by Atsuhiro Tomioka]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time storyboarders]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time directors]] [[Category:Episodes by one-time animation directors]] [[Category:Episodes which aired in the United States before Japan]] [[de:Pokémon Generationen Folge 10: Die Alte Villa]] [[es:GEN10]] [[fr:PG10]] [[it:PG10]] [[ja:PG第10話]] [[zh:宝可梦世代 第10集]]
